'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Bakhmut]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] [[Shell (projectile)|shell]] [[Bakhmut]] with [[artillery]] and [[BM-21 Grad|Grad rockets]], killing five people and injuring nine others. [https://news.yahoo.com/russia-shelling-bakhmut-kills-5-012932885.html (''The Kyiv Independent'' via Yahoo! News)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[2023 Karachi police station attack]]
***The [[Pakistani Taliban]] attack a [[police station]] in [[Karachi]]. Three [[militant]]s, three [[police officer]]s and a [[civilian]] are killed. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-south-asia-64678923 (BBC News)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[2023 Al-Sukhnah attack]]
***[[Islamic State]] militants kill at least 68 people, including 61 [[civilian]]s and seven [[Syrian Army|soldiers]], in [[al-Sukhnah, Syria|Al-Sukhnah]], [[Homs Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/suspected-is-attack-in-syria-death-toll-rises-to-68-monitor-505be31e (Barron's)]
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**At least 51 soldiers are killed when their convoy is [[ambush]]ed by [[Islamic extremism|jihadists]] on a road between [[Oursi Department|Oursi]] and [[Déou Department|Déou]]. At least 160 attackers are killed. [https://amp.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20230220-burkina-faso-au-moins-51-soldats-tu%C3%A9s-dans-une-embuscade (RFI)]
**[[Médecins Sans Frontières]] suspends its operations in [[Burkina Faso]] for an "indefinite" period, except when responding to [[lifesaving]] emergencies, following the killings of two of its [[Burkinabé nationality law|Burkinabé]] [[Humanitarian aid|aid worker]]s by armed men near [[Dédougou]] on 8 February. [https://www.barrons.com/news/msf-says-suspending-work-in-burkina-after-2-employees-killed-116958cf (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*Four people are killed and two others are injured, including [[Mamintal Alonto Adiong Jr.]], governor of [[Lanao del Sur]], when their convoy is [[ambush]]ed in [[Maguing]], [[Philippines]], by unknown gunmen. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/02/17/23/lanao-del-sur-governor-injured-4-others-killed-in-ambush (ABS-CBN News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Aftermath of the [[2023 Turkey–Syria earthquake]]
**A [[Syrians in Turkey|Syrian]] family of seven, including five children, are killed by a fire that struck a home in [[Konya Province]], [[Turkey]], which they moved to after surviving the [[earthquake]]. Seven other people are injured during the fire. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/2/17/after-surviving-earthquake-syrian-family-of-seven-dies-in-fire (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–South Africa relations]], [[China–South Africa relations]]
**The [[South African Navy]] hosts a ten-day joint [[military exercise]] in the [[Indian Ocean]] with [[Russia]] and [[China]]. The exercise is named "Mosi II" after the [[Tswana language|Tswana]] word for "smoke". [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-64380572 (BBC News)] [https://www.dw.com/en/south-africa-russia-china-drills-strain-ties-with-west/a-64709205 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Arkabutla shootings]]
**Six people are killed in a [[spree shooting]] in [[Arkabutla, Mississippi|Arkabutla]], [[Mississippi]], [[United States]]. A suspect has been arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-64684350 (BBC News)] [https://english.elpais.com/usa/2023-02-17/at-least-six-people-killed-during-shooting-spree-in-rural-mississippi.html (El País)]
*Eighteen people who have [[Illegal immigration|immigrated illegally]] from [[Afghanistan]] are found dead in an abandoned truck in [[Sofia City Province]], [[Bulgaria]]. Thirty-five others are hospitalized. Four people have been arrested. [http://theguardian.com/world/2023/feb/17/people-found-dead-in-truck-near-sofia-bulgaria (Reuters via ''The Guardian'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Japanese space program]]
**[[JAXA]] aborts the first launch attempt of the [[H3 (rocket)|H3]] [[Liquid-propellant rocket|rocket]] after some of its [[Solid rocket booster|booster]]s failed to ignite during the [[Multistage rocket|first stage]]. It is [[Japan]]'s second failed rocket launch since 2003. [https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/world/2023/02/501_345629.html (AFP via ''The Korea Times'')]
